title: Clean and refit a driver's floor mat
instruction: Brush the stuck dirt loose and vacuum the ribs and heel. Release both mat clips, lift the mat over the sill, tip the remaining grit into the tray, then refit the mat flat on both retention posts.
setup: Two native I2RT YAM arms work at a driver's footwell fixture with pedals, door sill, two retention posts, a ribbed mat with a pull lip and a collection tray. The left arm carries a passive bristle brush and the right carries a vacuum controlled by its jaw opening. The mat starts clipped down with 12 adhered clumps and 36 loose grit pieces.
scoring: Award 0.15 after both clips are released, up to 0.25 in proportion to the 12 adhered clumps loosened, and up to 0.40 in proportion to the 44-piece collection target. Award the final 0.20 when both clips are reseated and the released mat lies flat after the cleaning thresholds are met.
fidelity: Native dual-YAM joint actuators and collision geometry, a 1.00 N net tangential bristle contact-load threshold, jaw-travel motor interlock, bounded suction and compliant bin capture. The mat uses a compliant toe hinge, sensed retention clips and a compliant hold that requires two-pad contact.
scores: Scripted dual-YAM: 1.00 in 1,154 actions (12 clumps released, 26 pieces vacuumed, 18 in tray, both clips reseated). Vacuum-off cleaning control: 0.25. Original Dream-1 run and offline replay of its 1,200 actions: 0.00. Physical breakaway tolerance awaits bench measurement.
